value.rationale: A natural complete one-parameter subfamily of Fukasawa two-Galois-point curves has a sharp moduli-boundary phenomenon: ordinary p-fold singularities degenerate into unibranch cusps, inertia doubles in p-rank from p to p², and geometric genus/p-rank jump by 2(p-1) while remaining ordinary. These coupled invariants are not mere numerical recomputations and exactly refine a nonsharp earlier genus bound.
